evidence_boundaries: The LUXE paper reports implementation status, detector prototypes and simulated spectra or yields, not recorded electron-laser or photon-laser collision data.

The PINO paper validates a surrogate against the authors' two-dimensional resistive-MHD DNS; it is neither a kinetic PIC model nor a reconnection experiment, and high-S late plasmoid bursts produce 32-42% rate errors.
The MWPPAC paper uses real VAMOS++ events and an independent reference wire, but cross-run, cross-detector, nonlinear-response and long-term-drift generalization remain untested.
No LUXE end-to-end simulation, MHD DNS/PINO training or VAMOS++ raw-event replay was rerun locally.
